features.ctaTitle: Try the white-label app for {{days}} days

appoint.title: Bookings without the back-and-forth.
appoint.body: Give customers a beautiful way to discover availability, book instantly, and keep coming back. Starter is one location. Pro adds WhatsApp reminders, payments, a second office, and an ad-free app.

features.f1: White-label customer app so clients book under your brand
features.f3: Automated email reminders; WhatsApp on Pro
features.f4: Pro adds a second office, payments, full BI, reward points, and an ad-free customer app
features.f5: AI Assistant for plain-language questions about the day
features.f6: Automation Creator on Pro for reminders and staff offer hints

appoint.howLead: Customers book in your branded app. Your team runs the day from one calendar.

s1.title: Publish services and staff
s1.body: Set service durations, staff, rooms, and working hours so availability is always real.

s2.title: Customers book online
s2.body: They pick a time in your white-label app or web booking flow instead of calling the desk.

s3.title: Run and follow up
s3.body: Staff see the live calendar, send reminders, and keep customer history in one place.

appoint.benefitsLead: Fewer missed slots, less phone tag, and a customer app that looks like your brand.

b1.title: White-label booking app
b1.body: Clients install your brand — not a generic IE Orbit listing — on iOS and Android.

b2.title: One shared calendar
b2.body: Stop juggling diaries and WhatsApp chats. Everyone sees who is free and what is booked.

b3.title: Reminders that stick
b3.body: Email reminders on every plan; WhatsApp reminders on Pro to cut no-shows.

b4.title: Grow without chaos
b4.body: Add a second office, payments, full BI, and an ad-free app when you move to Pro.

appoint.pricingLead: {{days}}-day full-Pro trial, then Starter {{starter}} or Pro {{pro}} per month. White-label customer app included on every plan.

pro.f5: Full BI and ad-free customer app

mart.title: Your products, in their pocket.
mart.body: Create a storefront that makes your products easy to browse, buy, and remember — with POS and GST books in the same workspace. Starter is the counter plus online orders and returns; Pro unlocks Instant Delivery with Porter/Shiprocket, GST e-invoice, and Grow.

features.f1: White-label customer app so shoppers buy under your brand
features.f2: POS, catalog, online orders, and returns on Starter
features.f3: Instant Delivery with Porter/Shiprocket on Pro
features.f4: Day-book on Starter; GST reports, e-invoice, Grow, and e-way on Pro
features.f5: AI invoice extraction on Pro — photograph a supplier bill, review the lines, then add stock
features.f6: Automation Creator on Pro for birthday, occasion, and VIP rules

mart.howLead: Sell at the counter and online under your brand, with books that stay in the same workspace.

s1.title: Build your catalog
s1.body: Add products, prices, and stock so the counter and the customer app stay in sync.

s2.title: Sell anywhere
s2.body: Ring up walk-ins on POS and take online orders from your white-label shop app.

s3.title: Close the books
s3.body: Track sales day-book on Starter; unlock GST reports, e-invoice, and Grow tools on Pro.

mart.benefitsLead: One workspace for the counter, the online shop, and GST-ready books.

b1.title: White-label shop app
b1.body: Customers browse and order in an app that looks like your store, not a marketplace.

b2.title: Counter and catalog together
b2.body: POS, returns, and online orders share the same products and customer list.

b3.title: GST when you need it
b3.body: Day-book on Starter. GST reports, e-invoice, and e-way bill on Pro.

b4.title: Delivery and marketing on Pro
b4.body: Instant Delivery with Porter/Shiprocket plus Grow helpers for promos and listings.
